name: mission
_comment: Epic N — campaign brief -> mission YAML. Correctness is decided by the REAL validate-mission binary (subprocess), not by a re-implemented schema check, plus cheap semantic checks (requested sides declared, object count, weather preset). Scored as pass@1 and pass-after-one-repair, because the director pipeline is generate -> validate -> repair -> submit: a model that needs the validator's stderr to get there is still usable, one that cannot converge is not. Schema source of truth: docs/modding/missions.md.
system_prompt:
You generate mission files for a combat flight simulator. Output ONLY a YAML document — no prose, no explanation, no code fence.

Required top-level fields:
  name: string (non-empty)
  map: string (terrain id)
  layer: string (weather/lighting layer id)
  time: { hour: 0-23, minute: 0-59 }
  wind: { heading: 0-359, speed: >= 0 }   # speed in m/s
  sides: [list of coalition ids, at least 1]
  objects: [list, at least 1]
  triggers: [list]

Optional:
  weather: { preset: clear|partly_cloudy|overcast|rain|storm|snow|blizzard }
  time_scale: float > 0

Each entry of `objects` requires:
  type: string (aircraft/unit type id)
  id: string (UNIQUE across the file)
  side: string (MUST be one of the ids listed in top-level `sides`)
  pos: [x, y, z]  (exactly 3 numbers, metres; y is up)
  heading: number (degrees)
  alt: number (optional, metres)

Each entry of `triggers` requires:
  on: string   e.g. destroy(<object id>), timer(<seconds>), mission_start
  do: string   e.g. mission_success, mission_failure, spawn(<type>,<side>,[x,y,z])
Any object id referenced by destroy(...) MUST be one of the object ids you defined.

Example of a valid document:
name: "Storm Warning"
map: ukraine
layer: ukraine_clear
time: { hour: 14, minute: 0 }
wind: { heading: 270, speed: 12 }
sides: [nato, russia]
objects:
  - type: F22
    id: player1
    side: nato
    pos: [12400, 0, 8800]
    heading: 90
    alt: 500
  - type: SA10
    id: sam1
    side: russia
    pos: [15000, 0, 9000]
    heading: 0
triggers:
  - on: destroy(sam1)
    do: mission_success

cases.brief: Generate a SEAD mission. Coalitions: nato and russia. The player flies an F22 for nato. Place at least one russian SA10 site as the target. The mission succeeds when the SAM site is destroyed. Map: ukraine, layer ukraine_clear. Midday, light wind.

Generate a combat air patrol mission in bad weather. Coalitions: nato and russia. Two nato F15 fighters on patrol, at least two russian Su27 interceptors inbound. Weather preset must be storm. Map: ukraine, layer ukraine_overcast. Dawn (around 05:30), strong wind from the west.

Generate an escort mission with a time limit. Coalitions: nato and russia. A nato C130 transport must survive; escort it with one nato F16. Include at least one russian MiG29 threat. The mission fails if a timer of 600 seconds expires before the threat is destroyed. Map: ukraine, layer ukraine_clear.

Generate a mission with THREE coalitions: nato, russia and militia. At least one object per coalition. Map: ukraine, layer ukraine_clear. Night mission (around 23:00), calm wind, weather preset clear.

Generate an intercept mission in snow. Coalitions: nato and russia. One nato F22 intercepting two russian Tu95 bombers. Weather preset must be snow. Map: ukraine, layer ukraine_overcast. Early morning, moderate wind from the north. Mission succeeds when both bombers are destroyed.

Generate a large strike package mission. Coalitions: nato and russia. At least six objects total: multiple nato strike aircraft and escorts, and multiple russian ground targets and defenders. Map: ukraine, layer ukraine_clear. Afternoon, moderate wind. Mission succeeds when a specific named russian ground target is destroyed.
